messages:
oncall-bot: Incident detected — pager propagation: high alert churn in api-route-frontend, multiple escalations.
oncall-bot: Pager: critical: api-latency-spike (route: api-route-frontend) — p95 > 3s, error rate 2.6%.
Maria G.: on call, joining bridge now.
Dave H.: I'm in. initial mitigation: scaled dedicated pool and pinned fallback-model; starting canary rollbacks.
Jordan K.: saw sudden retry storm from our global LB — looks like 502/timeout cascade, not model degradation.
Maria G.: customer impact: session freezes for ~7% of connections in eu-west; flagged for CS outreach. No data loss reported.
SRE Ops: noting many teams were paged due to alert rule using "any-500" aggregation — we should dedupe.
Ava (PM): scheduling postmortem — suggested slot Wed 1600 PT. Can we confirm owners & action items before then?
Dave H.: action items: 1) Alert dedupe + routing change (owner @Dave H.) — ticket INC-7832. 2) Add transient suppression for retry storms (<5m window) (owner @Maria G.)
Jordan K.: 3) Add readout to network LB team re: knob that started spiking retry rate (owner @Jordan K.).
SRE Ops: 4) Update SLO breakpoints to include cascade detection (owner @SRE Ops) — add anomaly rule for tokenized latency deltas.
Maria G.: created a short mitigation doc in the thread: steps we ran, timeline, and rollback commands.
Maria G.: snippet for alert change:
```
- alert: ApiLatencyHigh
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 3
  for: 5m
  labels:
    team: api
  annotations:
    summary: "P95 latency above 3s"
```
SRE Ops: propose adding `relabeling` to route critical alerts only to oncall primary, others get pager-hold for 2m.
Ava (PM): can someone draft customer-facing blurb for CS? we should avoid technical jargon.
Dave H.: I'll draft and put in INC-7832. Also adding follow-up: run alert firehose over last 30 days to tune thresholds (owner @SRE Ops).
Maria G.: Postmortem prep checklist: timeline + logs (Dave), flow diagram (Jordan), alert rule diffs (SRE Ops), customer notes (Ava).
SRE Ops: scheduling retrospective board and action tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7832 (updated).
Maria G.: wrapping up — thanks all. I'll take ownership of coordinating the postmortem and collecting artifacts. :thumbsup:
